title: The reign of judges begins
scene: The people assembled in groups to cast their voices for judges; a written message from Mosiah is being considered.

title: Nehor is tried for killing Gideon
scene: Nehor standing defiantly before Alma at his judgment seat, surrounded by witnesses; no depiction of execution.

title: The sons of Mosiah depart
scene: Ammon blesses his fellow missionaries as they separate in the wilderness; travel-worn robes, quiet resolve. No palace or army.

title: Ammon defends the flocks
scene: Ammon stands with his sling poised beside the waters of Sebus while servants gather scattered flocks; attackers approach at a distance, no severed limbs or gore.

title: Persecution, work, and care for the poor
scene: Church members offering food and clothing to hungry and sick neighbors, without distinction of membership.

title: Lamoni believes Ammon
scene: Ammon teaches an attentive King Lamoni and his servants in the royal house, with reverent stillness and dramatic warm light.

title: Abish raises the queen
scene: Abish takes the queen by the hand and helps her rise before an astonished crowd in Lamoni’s house; other figures rest on the floor, alive, no injuries.

title: The prisoners of Middoni are freed
scene: Ammon reunites with his exhausted imprisoned brethren as Lamoni brings them out of confinement at Middoni; dignified, non-graphic depiction with modest clothing.

title: A king offers to give away his sins
scene: An older king kneels in prayer before Aaron inside a restrained ancient palace; crown and riches are secondary, no supernatural spectacle.

title: The Anti-Nephi-Lehies take a new name
scene: Aaron and fellow teachers address a gathering of newly converted families; an ancient civic setting, hopeful and solemn, no written new-name banner.

title: Weapons buried for peace
scene: A gathered community lowers swords and other weapons into a deep trench, heads bowed; earth, hands, and surrendered weapons dominate the scene.

title: The unresisting people are attacked
scene: Unarmed believers kneel in prayer before approaching warriors; one attacker lowers his sword, moved by their refusal to resist. No impact, gore, or injured children.

title: Amlici’s bid for a crown
scene: Amlici raised before his gathered followers as they proclaim him king after the public rejection.

title: Battle on the hill Amnihu
scene: Alma leading the Nephite defense on the hill above the river as the opposing ranks retreat; distant, non-graphic battle.

title: The battle at the Sidon crossing
scene: Alma and Amlici facing each other with swords beside the crowded river crossing, the larger battle behind them; no gore.

title: A second invasion is repelled
scene: Nephite troops advancing as the second invading force withdraws, with trampled grain fields showing the damage of war.

title: Mourning gives way to renewal
scene: Alma baptizing a convert in the Sidon as families wait along the riverbank.

title: Alma relinquishes the judgment seat
scene: Nephihah taking his place in the judgment seat while Alma turns toward the people he will teach.

title: A call to change in Zarahemla
scene: Alma speaking urgently to an attentive public assembly in Zarahemla.

title: Alma teaches in Gideon
scene: Alma teaching the gathered people of Gideon, a peaceful valley settlement behind them.

title: The ministry in Melek
scene: Families arriving from the wilderness borders to hear Alma in Melek.

title: An angel sends Alma back
scene: The sorrowing Alma encountering an angel on the road after his expulsion from Ammonihah.

title: Amulek refuses Zeezrom’s bribe
scene: Zeezrom offering silver to Amulek before a gathered crowd while Amulek refuses with an open hand; silver pieces without invented coin inscriptions.

title: The plan of redemption is taught
scene: Alma extending his hand in an urgent appeal to the assembled people, with Zeezrom listening intently.

title: The martyrs of Ammonihah
scene: A non-graphic memorial scene centered on the grief of bound Alma and Amulek, lit by a fire kept outside the frame; no burning bodies or visible victims.

title: The prison falls
scene: Alma and Amulek standing amid the fallen prison walls with broken cords, dust and light around them; figures modestly framed and no visible bodies.

title: Zeezrom is healed in Sidom
scene: Alma taking Zeezrom by the hand beside his sickbed, with Amulek nearby, at the moment of healing.

title: Ammonihah is destroyed
scene: The deserted ruins of Ammonihah after its destruction, buildings broken and smoke hanging over empty streets; no gore.

title: Zoram rescues the captives
scene: Zoram and his sons receiving the rescued families beside their army in the southern wilderness.

title: Persecution turns against the Amulonites
scene: Lamanite converts return to their own land and join a community burying weapons, with a distant wilderness behind them; no execution depicted.

title: The Church spreads through the land
scene: Alma and Amulek teaching a diverse gathering in an ancient sanctuary, with listeners receiving the message joyfully.

title: Alma and the missionaries reunite
scene: Alma embraces the returning missionaries along a wilderness path; Ammon is overcome with joy, supported by his brethren.

title: Refuge in the land of Jershon
scene: Families carrying bundles and leading their flocks enter a new land while Nephite protectors receive them; relief after a difficult journey.

title: A tremendous battle and mourning
scene: Bereaved families mourn beside returning Nephite soldiers after a devastating battle, weapons lowered; no graphic bodies or invented commander.

title: Korihor confronts Alma
scene: Korihor, suddenly unable to speak, reaches toward a writing surface before Alma and the chief judge; tense faces, no magic beams.

title: Alma encounters the Rameumptom
scene: A richly dressed Zoramite stands alone on a high narrow prayer platform with hands raised; Alma and his companions observe from below. No human sacrifice.

title: The word compared to a seed
scene: Alma teaches a gathering of poor listeners in coarse clothing on a hillside, his hand extended toward them; Amulek nearby. No literal magical tree or seed demonstration.

title: Jershon welcomes the expelled converts
scene: People of Ammon offer clothing and food to exhausted Zoramite refugees arriving with modest belongings; a scene of refuge and hospitality.

title: The people of Ammon move to Melek
scene: A refugee community departs Jershon with bundled possessions while Nephite troops move into the vacated land; two streams of travelers, solemn resolve.

title: Alma entrusts the sacred records to Helaman
scene: Alma instructs Helaman beside carefully kept engraved metal records; an intimate, lamplit scene, no invented insignia, secret society, or magical effects.

title: Alma counsels faithful Shiblon
scene: Alma speaks privately with Shiblon, a patient listener in simple travel clothing; the father’s hand lifted in counsel, subdued warmth.

title: Alma calls Corianton back to his ministry
scene: Alma counsels a troubled Corianton privately; father and son face one another across a quiet room, compassionate but serious. No depiction of sexual activity.

title: The battle at the river Sidon
scene: Moroni halts his soldiers beside the river as the surrounded opposing army lowers its weapons; armor, shields and thick clothing on the Nephites, no graphic injuries.

title: Alma’s last charge and departure
scene: Alma departing alone along a road from Zarahemla toward Melek; a solemn human departure, without depicting an unconfirmed ascension.

title: Moroni raises the title of liberty
scene: Armored Moroni raises the torn garment on a pole as people gather and cast torn garments at his feet; an urgent civic covenant, no invented emblem.

title: Lehonti is betrayed at Antipas
scene: A guarded meeting between Lehonti and Amalickiah just below the mountaintop encampment, with soldiers and tents in the distance.

title: Amalickiah takes the Lamanite throne
scene: Amalickiah and the false witnesses stand before the seated Lamanite queen in a tense court hearing, without showing the murder.

title: The fortified cities hold
scene: Lehi’s defenders hold the narrow entrance of Noah behind high earthworks as attackers approach the ditch; defensive shields, arrows and stones, no graphic casualties.

title: Fortifications and new coastal cities
scene: Builders raise timber defenses above an earth bank while families and supplies arrive at a new coastal settlement.

title: Morianton’s flight is stopped
scene: The escaped maidservant urgently reports Morianton’s planned flight to Moroni at his camp; the scene conveys resolve rather than depicting her abuse.

title: Pahoran succeeds Nephihah
scene: Pahoran takes his judicial oath before assembled people, beside the judgment seat.

title: The king-men challenge the government
scene: A divided civic assembly confronts the question of monarchy, with Pahoran and petitioners facing the gathered people; no invented political insignia.

title: Amalickiah captures the eastern cities
scene: Teancum’s army bars the coastward advance near Bountiful as Amalickiah’s force approaches after capturing fortified cities.

title: Teancum kills Amalickiah
scene: Teancum approaches Amalickiah’s silent tent in the coastal camp at night, carrying a javelin; show suspense before the killing.

title: Ammoron opens a western front
scene: Ammoron’s army marches toward the western border while messengers carry military orders; one grounded marching scene, no invented named soldiers.

title: Two thousand sons join Helaman
scene: Helaman arrives at weary Judea with the young volunteer soldiers, welcomed by Antipus beside unfinished defenses.

title: The young soldiers turn back to battle
scene: Helaman and his young soldiers choose to turn back from their flight to aid the army of Antipus, a resolute moment in the wilderness.

title: Mulek is retaken by a feigned retreat
scene: Teancum’s small force retreats north along the shore, drawing a much larger army away from the fortified city of Mulek.

title: Bountiful becomes a prison stronghold
scene: Prisoners under guard build Bountiful’s high timber-and-earth wall, with a deep ditch in front; no glorification of captivity.

title: Antiparah is abandoned
scene: Helaman’s soldiers approach the open defenses of abandoned Antiparah as the last opposing column withdraws in the distance.

title: The prisoner exchange breaks down
scene: Moroni reads Ammoron’s letter in a military camp as a messenger waits, surrounded by the practical burdens of provisioning an army.

title: The prisoners of Gid are freed
scene: In profound night silence, weapons are passed over Gid’s wall to waiting prisoners while the guards sleep; avoid depicting harm to sleeping guards.

title: Cumeni falls and survives a counterattack
scene: After defending Cumeni, Helaman checks the wounded young soldiers as companions dress their injuries; exhausted relief, wrapped wounds, no graphic injury.

title: Prayer and stratagem recover Manti
scene: Helaman’s exhausted army prays together before attempting to recover Manti, with a modest camp and sparse provisions.

title: Nephihah falls as the armies await help
scene: Refugees from Nephihah reach Moroni’s army after the city falls, carrying what they can while he receives news of the loss.

title: Pahoran reveals the rebellion
scene: Pahoran writes his reply from refuge in Gideon, with loyal supporters gathering behind him.

title: Pahoran is restored in Zarahemla
scene: Moroni and Pahoran lead their united force toward Zarahemla, with the standard of liberty raised and the city ahead.

title: Nephihah is recovered by night
scene: Nephite soldiers quietly descend strong cords and ladders inside Nephihah’s western wall while the opposing camp sleeps near the eastern entrance.

title: Teancum’s final mission and the war’s end
scene: Teancum lowers himself over Moroni’s wall with a cord at night, carrying his javelin into the enemy-held city; show the dangerous approach rather than the deaths.

title: Peace, renewal, and a new commander
scene: Helaman teaches a gathering of returning families and former soldiers during the restoration of peaceful life.

title: Shiblon receives the records; Moroni dies
scene: Shiblon tends the sacred records in a quiet room; physical appearance and room design are illustrative rather than specified.

title: Hagoth’s ships and the northward migrations
scene: Families with provisions board Hagoth’s large wooden ship on the west sea near the narrow neck, ready for a northward journey.

title: Helaman receives the records; Moronihah repels an attack
scene: Shiblon entrusts the sacred records to the younger Helaman in a solemn handover.

title: A contested succession and Kishkumen’s murder
scene: Disguised Kishkumen escapes through the city after the attack on the judgment seat, with pursuers behind him; no graphic violence.

title: Coriantumr takes Zarahemla
scene: Coriantumr’s army surges through Zarahemla’s breached entrance while inhabitants flee deeper into the city; Coriantumr is a large, mighty man as the text describes, no novel likeness.

title: Zarahemla is retaken
scene: The trapped invading army lowers its weapons between the forces of Lehi and Moronihah; the capital’s recapture ends the sequence without graphic casualties.
